text:
elaine-eng: FYI customer reported they were billed for stream tokens AND the toolcall after they closed the stream mid-toolcall.
raj-ops: can you drop the log link+sample session id?
elaine-eng: https://logs.redwood.internal/session/abc123. Sequence: stream emitted ~95 tokens, client triggered tool_call->dispatch, client disconnected. Router retried and routed to fallback model, emitted ~30 extra tokens, toolcall later completed and we recorded ~60 tool tokens. Customer saw 95+30+60 on invoice.
zara-ml: Oof. Are toolcall tokens currently charged at dispatch or completion?
elaine-eng: charged at dispatch today. Stream tokens charged as they stream out.
ton y-console: that explains the spike in billing UI; the timeline only surfaces final charges so it's hard to untangle provisional events.
raj-ops: Two problems: (A) accounting race when client disconnect + router retry -> duplicate/overlapped emissions, (B) console/telemetry lacks provisional vs finalized clarity.
zara-ml: Proposal: mark toolcall charges provisional at dispatch, finalize (or rollback) at toolcall_outcome. Introduce stable toolcall_id propagated across retries so we can dedupe.
elaine-eng: Rough ledger flow:
```
// events emitted by router/runtime
session_start(sid)
stream_emit(sid, n_tokens)
toolcall_dispatch(tool_id, sid, est_tokens)
router_retry(new_route, sid, session_epoch)
stream_emit(sid, n_tokens) // from retry
toolcall_outcome(tool_id, actual_tokens, status)
```
Ledger rules:
- provisional entries created for stream emits and toolcall dispatches
- toolcall provisional tagged with toolcall_id
- on toolcall_outcome: replace provisional with finalized charge (could be higher/lower)
- if toolcall TTL expires without outcome => mark orphaned and surface in ops UI
- if a reconnect/replay occurs, prefer charges where prefix_owner matches session_epoch, dedupe by toolcall_id
```

ton y-console: UX needs: provisional badge on timeline items, filter for provisional/orphaned, and a "related events" inspector showing stream emits + associated toolcall provisional/final. Tooltip copy: "Provisional charges may be adjusted when external tool calls complete." :info:
raj-ops: Telemetry events to add:
- charge.provisional.created (kind=stream|toolcall, id?)
- charge.finalized (id, final_amount)
- charge.orphaned (id)
- session.replay
These let us compute orphan rate.
elaine-eng: Can we gate behind feature flags? I'd like a 1% canary.
zara-ml: Yes. Router flag: accounting.model=provisional_v2; Console feature flag: show_provisional=true. PRs will include unit tests for disconnect+replay and integration that simulates toolcall TTLs.
raj-ops: SQL to find orphaned toolcalls last week:
```
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orphaned
FROM ledger_events e
WHERE e.event_type='provisional_toolcall' AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM ledger_events f WHERE f.toolcall_id=e.toolcall_id AND f.event_type='finalize_toolcall'
) AND e.created_at > now() - interval '7 days';
```
ton y-console: Ill wire that to billing diagnostics card. Also add a small explainer modal in console for early rollouts.
billing-bot: created ticket RB-2917 linking affected invoices and flagged for manual credit review.
elaine-eng: Migration note: need script to scan old provisional rows with no finalize and backfill as orphaned with created_at < migration_cutoff.
zara-ml: Edge case: router replay may emit overlapping token ranges. We'll add prefix_hash and prefix_owner=(route_id, session_epoch) into traces and ledger rows so dedupe logic can map tokens to owner.
raj-ops: Monitoring: alert if orphaned_toolcall_rate > 0.1% or if provisional_to_final delta > 25% for a billing period.
elaine-eng: Plan: 1) ledger schema change (provisional flag + toolcall_id + prefix_owner) 2) router runtime changes + flag 3) console + metrics 4) migration script 5) canary -> expand. I'll open PRs and link here.
ton y-console: I'll post a mockup in the thread once ready and add copy suggestions.
elaine-eng: thanks everyone. follow-up: customer outreach already queued by billing-bot. closing this sync for now.
